title: Day 1: How To Dance Alkayida! (Afro Dance Advent Calendar for Beginners!)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Isaac M.I.K. uses an encouraging and structured step-by-step approach, breaking down complex rhythms into manageable components. He combines verbal counting with enthusiastic reinforcement to build student confidence.

lesson_structure.note: Welcome and introduction of the Alkayida dance.
Breaking down the groove and double bounce.
Adding the leaning and arm movements.
Practicing the steps slowly with counts.
Dancing Alkayida along with the music.

steps_taught.name: Alkayida Groove
steps_taught.description: Double bounce with cross and open arm movements while leaning

what_works: breaking the move down into groove, arms, and leaning
what_hinders: maintaining the continuous double bounce can be challenging

quotes.text: Firstly, let's get the groove right, which is very important, guys.
I think the hardest part is actually to keep the double bounce constantly.
I hope you guys enjoyed day number one and sweet flow from Ghana.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates the Alkayida dance move briefly facing forward.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot weight distribution due to baggy pants

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates the double bounce rhythm.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking a single street dance down into three distinct layers: groove/bounce, arms, and body lean before putting them together.
